utterance.raw:
Look, I get how this looks — I'm the one who put myself in both rooms, and I did that on purpose because lying about my route when people might have seen me would be worse. Let me push back though.

Frank, you just said you were in Medbay too. You went Cafeteria -> Medbay -> Cafeteria -> Weapons. If Bob entered Medbay at tick 8 from Upper Engine (which matches what Charlie saw), and I left Medbay after seeing him arrive, then Frank's Medbay visit overlaps with mine or comes right after. You're claiming you saw nothing — no Bob, no body. That's only possible if you were in Medbay before tick 8, OR you were there after and you're lying about not seeing the body.

Also, Frank, you have no witnesses for any leg of your route. Cafeteria, Medbay, Cafeteria, Weapons — nobody places you anywhere. At least Charlie's account corroborates that Bob went toward Medbay, which matches what I saw.

I'm not going to pretend my position is comfortable — it isn't. But the easy vote on me ignores that Frank's route also touches Medbay with zero corroboration. I think we need to slow down before locking in on me. I'd rather skip this vote than get it wrong with this little info.
